name: GPU Backprojection using OpenCL Buffers
aliases: GPU Backprojection using OpenCL Buffers — Full GPU Path
definition: GPU-based backprojection using OpenCL buffers for data storage.
summary: GPU Backprojection using OpenCL Buffers is a tomographic reconstruction pipeline that stores projection data in global memory buffers to avoid texture sampling hardware while explicitly including the ramp filtering step in the GPU path.
